text: {"question":"Which part of the analysis demonstrates that the variable‑curvature model shows a deceleration phase close to redshift 0, contrary to the GDE model?","reference_answer":"The cosmographic plots in Fig. 13 reveal that the variable‑curvature model has a negative deceleration parameter q(z) near z = 0, indicating a decelerated expansion, whereas the GDE model remains positive (accelerated) at all redshifts, as explicitly noted in the text."}
